H2 — Conclusions and Best Practices

Fa

H3 — 1. Don't Rely Only on Documentation
Test real data; method presence injan API wrapper # functionality.

H3 — 2. Choose Method for the Task
Match task to method (‘watchBidsAsks° for bulk, watchOrderBook’ for detail).

H3 — 3. Optimize Traffic

1000x efficiency gains are geometrically possible by selecting the correct endpoint.

H3 — 4. Prepare for Failures
Exponential backoff and structure/freshness quality checks are non-negotiable.

H3 — 5. Test at Production Loads
API behavior differs dramatically under live load versus singular test requests.

H2 — Future of WebSocket APIs for Orderbooks
H2 — Conclusion

H3 — Industry Vectors

Moving toward:
Method unification between venues
Accurate living documentation
Efficient data compression protocols
Improved debugging tools

H3 — Final Synthesis

CCXT significantly simplifies integration by unifying
interfaces, but the underlying reality remains vastly
more complex than the documentation suggests.
Reliable data infrastructure requires localized
testing, rigorous monitoring, and right-sizing the
subscription method to the exact venue limit.
